description: Generate barcodes in common formats — CODE128, CODE39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC and ITF-14 — and download them as PNG or SVG images.

faqs.a: CODE128 is the most flexible: it encodes letters, numbers and symbols of any length. Use it unless a retailer specifically requires an EAN or UPC code.
faqs.q: Which barcode format should I choose?

faqs.a: EAN-13 and UPC codes are strict retail formats. EAN-13 needs exactly 12 or 13 digits, EAN-8 needs 7 or 8, UPC needs 11 or 12. CODE128 has no such restriction.
faqs.q: Why does the generator reject my number?

faqs.a: Yes — the codes are generated in your browser and are free to use. Real retail product codes must be registered with GS1 to be scannable in stores.
faqs.q: Are the generated barcodes free to use commercially?

howto: Enter the value you want to encode.
Choose a barcode format from the dropdown.
Click Generate Barcode to preview it.
Download the result as PNG or SVG.
title: Barcode Generator
